details:
- CVE-2026-34980: filter control characters from option values in the
  scheduler to prevent PPD keyword injection via Print-Job
- CVE-2026-39314: range check job-password-supported to prevent integer
  underflow in _ppdCreateFromIPP
- CVE-2026-39316: expire per-printer subscriptions before deleting the
  printer to prevent use-after-free in cupsdDeleteTemporaryPrinters
